pass_bar.description: Deployed tabular estimator LOPO MAE at least 15% below dummy LOPO, R² > 0, n_studies >= 15. Ridge/HGB are reported; HGB may deploy only at n_studies>=40. Lookup always serves shrinkage (empirical Bayes: kernel + material prior), never dummy or a net.

notes: This is the MVP scientific metric on hand-curated live/dead only. Simulated holdout R² is not.
Auto-promoted pmid* rows are excluded from this split.
Do not add unpaired regex hits to inflate n_rows.

Deployed estimator is the LOPO winner among dummy, material-class mean, and shrinkage; dummy is never served (shrinkage stays if dummy would win). Ridge overfits this table. HGB is computed every run but eligible to deploy only at >=40 papers.
